description: This file defines the HotelRoomReservation class and related functions for managing hotel room reservations, including validation, rate setting, and availability checks within a hotel management system.

classes.name: HotelRoomUnavailableError
classes.description: Custom exception for hotel room unavailability.

classes.name: HotelRoomPricingNotSetError
classes.description: Custom exception for missing hotel room pricing.

classes.name: HotelRoomReservation
classes.description: Main class representing a hotel room reservation, handling validation, rate calculation, and availability checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the reservation, setting total rooms, rates, and availability.

methods.name: validate_availability
methods.description: Checks if requested rooms are available for the reservation dates.

methods.name: get_total_rooms
methods.description: Retrieves total number of rooms of a specific item type.

methods.name: set_rates
methods.description: Calculates and sets the rates and total amount for the reservation items.
